# Test cases excluded from the Linux CI run because the GLFW/OpenGL 4.1
# backend does not implement what they check yet (see TODO.md).
# One Catch2 test case name per line; lines starting with '#' are comments.
# Remove a line once the backend passes that case.

# ConstantBuffer_GL4 is a stub: user constant buffers are not uploaded.
ConstantBuffer.independent_slots_and_integer_payload
ConstantBuffer.persists_across_flush_and_frames
ConstantBuffer.repeated_scopes_render_snapshots
ConstantBuffer.sample_shaders_snapshot_and_PMA
ConstantBuffer.scope_spans_frames_and_restores_snapshot
ConstantBuffer.scopes_restore_and_move
ConstantBuffer.size_boundaries_and_flush
QuadWarp.custom_stages_and_vertex_colors
QuadWarp.draw_state_and_batching
QuadWarp.pattern_curves_and_text
Renderer2D.pipeline_texture_constants

# CRenderer2D_GL4 does not report triangle counts to the Profiler.
LineString.cap_combinations
LineString.index_count_with_caps
LineString.rejected_body_has_no_caps
Renderer2D.circle_dashed_frame_short_arcs
Renderer2D.circle_dashed_frame_styles
Renderer2D.index_count_boundaries
Renderer2D.indexed_grid_draw
Renderer2D.polygon_index_count

# CTexture_GL4 does not implement dynamic texture fill or mipmap generation.
DynamicTexture.fill.NonSquare
DynamicTexture.fillRegion
DynamicTexture.generateMips

# The Linux FileSystem has no resource-path support.
FileSystem::CreateParentDirectories
FileSystem::IsResourcePath
